qualification: N10.3 diagnostic only. One-variable planner-velocity candidate derived from #340/#341 B-spline control-point derivative maxima; this is not a physical or acceptance speed limit. The runtime goal profile retains and monitors the existing 0.12 m/s vector-speed limit. Not a formal N11-N16 profile.
rationale: One-variable contrast against config/components/mapping/n10_horizon2_calibration.json: only per-axis planner max_velocity_m_s changes from 0.10 to 0.31. The candidate is derived from #340/#341 measured initial/final B-spline control-point derivative maxima (0.190426-0.305505 m/s), not from measured vehicle speed. Acceleration, horizon, map/inflation, sensors, freshness, official_ego policy, goal and acceptance criteria remain fixed. The N10 goal runner monitors both READY EGO reference vector speed and PX4 local-position vector speed against the original 0.12 m/s calibration limit; a violation cancels the action and enters caller STOP_HOLD plus bridge-owned landing. A generated reference over 0.12 m/s is a failed diagnostic even if the PX4 speed has not yet crossed the limit.
